statement: Samsung generated 7% of global chip foundry revenue in Q1 2026 versus more than 70% for TSMC.
why: With one foundry holding over seventy percent of the market, the ability of accelerator makers to find alternative leading-edge capacity is narrow, so any second-source tightening matters more.

impact.mechanism: Extreme supplier concentration in leading-edge foundry means accelerator supply depends on a single dominant manufacturer, with limited second-source relief when capacity tightens.

evidence.excerpt: Samsung generated 7% of global chip foundry revenue in Q1 2026, compared with more than 70% for TSMC.

confidence.basis: Market-share figures relayed in a single wire story without a named research provider; secondary-only.
